## `Assets/Graphics/Backgrounds/Backdrops.h`

- `enum class BackdropRole { Menu, Play, Gallery }` — The theme's background roles (CurrentTheme().backdrop); their colours are the theme's.
- `[[nodiscard]] const BackdropStyle& ThemeBackdrop(BackdropRole role)`
- `void DrawBackdropGrid(Painter& paint, BackdropRole role, const FloatRect& area)` — Grid, vignette and scanlines are separate calls; the view chooses their order.
- `void DrawBackdropVignette(Painter& paint, BackdropRole role, const FloatRect& area)` — Draws nothing for roles without a vignette.
- `void DrawBackdropScanlines(Painter& paint, BackdropRole role, const FloatRect& area)`
- `void DrawScanlineOverlay(Painter& paint, const FloatRect& area, float alpha)` — The theme's scanlines at 'alpha', for layers over a scene (a card screen).
